name: Backups
description: Last run of every backup job and scheduled job: Proxmox backups of each machine, database and app dumps, off-site copies, property-search.
templateLines: <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Last run of each job, UK time. Proxmox nightly: prx1 03:30, prx2 02:30.</Text>
<SimpleGrid cols={{ base: 2, sm: 4 }} spacing="xs" verticalSpacing="xs" style={{ flex: 1, gridAutoRows: "1fr" }}>
<Paper key={row[0]} p="xs" radius="sm" withBorder style={{ minWidth: 0, display: "flex", alignItems: "center" }}>
<Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>

<Text size="xs" c="dimmed" truncate>{(data[row[2]]?.data ?? []).find(task => task.id === row[3]) ? Date.toLocaleString((data[row[2]]?.data ?? []).find(task => task.id === row[3]).endtime * 1000, "en-GB", "Europe/London") : "no run found"}</Text>

<Badge size="sm" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} color={(data[row[2]]?.data ?? []).find(task => task.id === row[3])?.status === "OK" ? "green" : (data[row[2]]?.data ?? []).find(task => task.id === row[3]) ? "red" : "gray"}>{(data[row[2]]?.data ?? []).find(task => task.id === row[3])?.status === "OK" ? "OK" : (data[row[2]]?.data ?? []).find(task => task.id === row[3]) ? "Failed" : "None"}</Badge>
{[["Database dumps", "prdsrv2", "14"], ["App dumps", "prdsrv1", "16"], ["Off-site copy", "prdsrv2", "15"], ["Off-site copy", "prdsrv1", "17"], ["property-search", "4× a day", "12"]].map(row =>
<Paper key={row[0] + row[1]} p="xs" radius="sm" withBorder style={{ minWidth: 0, display: "flex", alignItems: "center" }}>
<Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
{status.prx1?.ok === false || status.prx2?.ok === false || status.kuma?.ok === false ? <Text size="xs" c="red">Some sources could not be read; refresh to retry.</Text> : null}
